tasks.label: Build AVR (Active File)
args: mkdir -p build && /opt/avr8-gnu-toolchain-linux_x86_64/bin/avr-gcc -mmcu=atmega32 -D__AVR_ATmega32__  -Os -Wall -std=c11 ${file} -o build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.elf && /opt/avr8-gnu-toolchain-linux_x86_64/bin/avr-objcopy -O ihex build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.elf build/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.hex
tasks.detail: Builds the active C file for ATmega32 and creates dynamically named .elf and .hex files in the build/ directory.
